overview.description: The Integrity Dividend Harvest ETF (DIVH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund invests in dividend-paying equity securities, targeting companies that have consistently increased dividends. The actively managed fund may invest up to 30% in non-US securities. DIVH was launched on Sep 2, 2026 and is issued by Integrity.
